citation.title: Latent ODEs for Irregularly-Sampled Time Series
citation.authors: Yulia Rubanova; Ricky T. Q. Chen; David Duvenaud
citation.venue: arXiv preprint (supplied text is v1 preprint; NeurIPS 2019 publication per citation hint, not verified from supplied text)

topic: Continuous-time neural ODE models (ODE-RNN, Latent ODE) for irregularly sampled, sparse time series
own_question: Can ODE-defined hidden dynamics improve RNN-type models on irregularly sampled data for interpolation, extrapolation and classification?
actual_method_and_evidence: ODE-RNN uses a GRU update at observations and ODE evolution between them. The Latent ODE uses an ODE-RNN encoder and a VAE objective. An optional Poisson-process likelihood models observation times. Evaluation used a toy sinusoid dataset, simulated MuJoCo Hopper data, PhysioNet 2012 ICU data and Human Activity data. Data were randomly split 80/20 train/test. Reported MSE was lower than the RNN baselines on several tasks. Autoregressive extrapolation was poor. Interpolation tasks encode the full window, so they are not causal. No fusion or plasma data were used.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Neural-ODE recurrent models are one familiar family for handling arbitrary gaps between irregular observations without fixed binning.
claim_checks.qualification: This is a general ML method. It was not validated on plasma diagnostics or for causal latency-constrained nowcasting. The interpolation encoder runs backwards over future points.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are observed values and timestamps. Targets are reconstruction of held-out points or the later half. Interpolation is noncausal. Report-arrival latency is not modeled.
validation_if_relevant: Random 80/20 split. No campaign- or shot-grouped validation is analogous to ours.
forbidden_inferences: That ODE models would improve CES nowcasting
That our estimators are novel relative to this work
That the Poisson rate maps to CES report arrival
That its interpolation results reflect causal performance
That it says anything about impurity Ti or BES/ECEI
reason_to_include_or_exclude: It could optionally be cited as background on irregular-sampling ML if the paper mentions that family of models. We did not implement it, so citing it is not necessary.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
